Package com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item

Class SomeBucketItem

java.lang.Object
net.minecraft.world.item.Item
com.github.crittscott.somebuckets.item.SomeBucketItem
All Implemented Interfaces:
net.minecraft.world.flag.FeatureElement, net.minecraft.world.level.ItemLike
Direct Known Subclasses:
FluidBucketItem, JBItem, MBItem
public abstract class SomeBucketItem extends net.minecraft.world.item.Item
Base of every Some Buckets item. Each stacks like a vanilla empty bucket (16) while empty and like a filled bucket (1) once it holds any content; BucketState writes the matching MAX_STACK_SIZE component whenever content changes. Malformed state is discarded when a stack is decoded, and a recognized legacy payload is migrated on the server while the stack is carried.
